quiz.question: Which technology distributes content geographically to reduce latency?
options: Load Balancer with geographic routing policies
quiz.explanation: A CDN caches files on edge servers around the world so downloads are served from a location close to the user.

quiz.question: Why should clients upload files directly to blob storage using presigned URLs?
options: It avoids sending large file bytes through our own servers
It removes the need for file metadata
quiz.explanation: Presigned URLs let the client stream bytes straight to S3, so our file service only handles small metadata requests.

quiz.question: What makes resumable uploads of a 50GB file possible?
options: Chunking the file and tracking which chunks have been uploaded
Storing the file in the metadata DB
quiz.explanation: Splitting the file into 5-10MB chunks with fingerprints means an interrupted upload only needs to resend the missing chunks.

quiz.question: When both compression and encryption are used, what is the correct order?
options: Only one can be used at a time
quiz.explanation: Encrypted data looks random and doesn't compress, so you compress first and then encrypt.
